title: Monitoring
description: Health checks, metrics of the API process, retention and tracing as reported by the Axentra server.

health.readinessHelp: Whether the server can serve requests (GET /v1/health/ready). A failing check makes the server answer 503.
health.livenessHelp: Whether the server process answers at all (GET /v1/health/live).

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: GET /metrics – Prometheus counters of the API process that answered this request.
metrics.perProcess: Values are counted since this API process started. Each process (and the separate notification dispatcher or worker) keeps its own counters, so scrape every process for a complete picture.
metrics.disabledBody: The server answers 404: metrics are switched off (observability.metrics_enabled = false), or this is a production server without observability.metrics_token_ref, where metrics stay disabled until a token is configured.
metrics.tokenRequiredBody: This server protects /metrics with a bearer token (observability.metrics_token_ref). Enter the token to view the metrics.
metrics.tokenRejected: The server did not accept this token.
metrics.tokenHelp: Kept only in this page while it is open; never stored.
metrics.tokenInfo: The token is the secret the operator configured in observability.metrics_token_ref. It is sent only to /metrics, as a bearer token.

ops.title: Retention and tracing
ops.forbidden: Retention and tracing settings are shown to platform administrators and product owners and admins only (GET /v1/settings).
ops.retentionHelp: Retention periods reported by GET /v1/settings. Data is removed when the maintenance task runs.
ops.purgeHint: Nothing is deleted automatically: older data is removed when the operator runs
ops.tracingHelp: OpenTelemetry and log settings reported by GET /v1/settings.
